_server_host_note: The exhibition value: the MacBook's reserved wired lease on the TP-Link Archer C50 coral LAN. If the Mac is on Wi-Fi instead it answers on 192.168.50.11, and while its reservation is unbound it may hold a pool address in 192.168.50.100-199 — check before assuming.
_bleach_crossfade_note: Seconds for a full 0->1 slew on the 1->2 bleach latch only; the tissue travels fluor_point->1, so it drains to white in HALF this (13.0 -> ~6.5s). Its own rate because the projection answers the same cue with a ~20s fluorescent->bleached one-shot: the phone should arrive first, but not five times over. Everything else keeps crossfade_s.
_magnifier_blur_note: blur 0..1 = how soft everything except the footage goes; onset = the reveal at which it reaches full and holds. Small onset means the screen is already soft while the opening is still one corallite wide.
_hud_note: The diagnostic overlay — a translucent black panel of text at the top-left. true for bench work, false for the exhibition. It can also be toggled live with a three-finger tap, but only while this is true.
